description: A search cancelled while in flight. debug_stall_ms holds the request before it reaches the catalog, the cancel notification arrives while it is still there, and the adapter answers the cancel with an error rather than a late result. The code is -32007 deadline_exceeded: an abandoned request ran out of time, which is a different condition from an adapter declining a budget up front.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
